title: Studio: switch a read-only package's flow off for this deployment from the Automations pillar — ledger switch on the item, posture-aware, refusal verbatim
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 — **re-scoped** from ADR-0146 child 2b on the maintainer's rulings of 2026-10-30, verbatim: 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」 · 「#28148 只继续本部署开关，克隆部分停」 · 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」. The original body (2b, switch + Clone) is in this card's edit history. The claim (6525340005) and assignee stand. The pause recorded in 6525828736 (「2a、2b 开发暂停 #28147 和 #28148 上」) is **lifted for this re-scoped card** — maintainer, 2026-10-31, verbatim: 「这些卡都可以放回车队开发吧」. Resume from `claude/project-thread-dhj1ou@1a9e7703b4`, drop the Clone half.

Part of #28236 (P0, child **N-04**) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: S–M · work so far: `claude/project-thread-dhj1ou@1a9e7703b4` (unreviewed).

**Business reason.** In Studio a read-only package's flow shows a locked switch that reads the flow **definition**, beside a status chip that reads the deployment **ledger** — they disagree. Measured at `d6c0a75f1a` (showcase): after the ledger switched `showcase_urgent_task_alert` off, the header read 「状态: 已停用 — 不会运行」 next to 「🔒 已启用」. An administrator cannot switch a packaged flow off where they look at it; they must find Setup → Packaged automation.

**Wanted.**
1. On a read-only package's flow in the Automations pillar: a **ledger switch** worded "off for this deployment", bound to `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` + `POST /api/v1/automation/<name>/toggle`; its three readings from `views/setup/packagedFlows.ts#activationReading` (on / enabled-but-not-running with the server's reason verbatim / off). A writable package's flow keeps its definition switch — two controls, two words.
2. Authority stays the server's: disabled in the console's own words for a principal the ledger gate refuses, read from the **two facts** (`useTenancyPosture()` → `features.tenancyPosture`, `user.isPlatformAdmin`) — ⛔ not `walledCatalogReadOnly` itself, which answers `false` for a flow (director note 6526396053); after an attempt, the server's refusal shown verbatim. Share the toggle request with `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` (one module), no second copy.
3. Remove the read-only hint "请切换或新建可写软件包后再编辑" from the flow switch.
4. Tests: switch bound to the ledger, not `status`; the measured disagreement case reads "off"; walled non-platform-admin disabled, `single` enabled; refusal verbatim; writable package's row unchanged.

**Not here (moved).** Clone → epic child N-22 ("new similar", into `<base>.custom`); the action ledger switch → #27842/#27504; customizing the flow → N-18.

**Dedupe.** #27356 rows 19/21, PR #27376, #27504/#27842 (actions). No other open card puts the ledger switch on the item.

Links back: #28236, #28130 (superseded), ADR-0126 §7.2/§7.4.
